test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

No sooner had I reached the station __when the train started moving__.

options.text: when the train had started moving
then the train had started moving

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct phrase to be substituted in the above sentence is **"than the train started moving".**
 
• The given sentence follows the law of inversion:** [Adverb + Helping verb + subject + main verb.....].**
 
• **"No sooner"** is used as an **adverb** which is followed by a helping verb **"had"**, but it is to be noted that **"No sooner"** always comes with **"than"** and not with **"when"**.
 
 
• **Example**: ***No sooner** had I entered the class **than** it began to rain.*
 
 
 
• Hence, **"than the train started moving"** is the correct phrase to be substituted.

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**.

**Correct Sentence**: "No sooner had I reached the station **than the train started moving.**__"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Law of inversion:
 
• Structure of Normal sentence: **"Subject + Helping verb + Main verb + ....."**
 
 
• **Example**: *I have never seen such a beautiful place.*
 
 
 
• Structure of Inversion sentence: **"Helping verb + Subject + Main verb + ....."**
 
 
• **Example**: *Never have I seen such a beautiful place.*
